Talent0_2Ability.name: Veiled Razor
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects:
If equipped with two Machine Guns, triggers <buf ID=900095>[Dual Gun Retaliation]</buf> when retaliating, dealing <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times.
After taking action, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=2015509>[Retaliation Enhancement]</buf>. Stacks up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Veiled Razor
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
If equipped with two Machine Guns, triggers <buf ID=900095>[Dual Gun Retaliation]</buf> when retaliating, dealing <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times.
After taking action, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=2015509>[Retaliation Enhancement]</buf>. Stacks up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times.
Gains <color=#F74848>1</color> AP when retaliating. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

200001.name: CEC 1
200001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, use Assault Weapons to launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

201502.name: Continuous Maintenance
201502.SpecificEffects: When Retaliation deals damage, restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>25%</color> of the damage dealt to undestroyed parts after combat.

201503.name: Firestorm
201503.describe: Simultaneously uses two Machine Guns to attack all targets within a <range type=1>fan-shaped area ahead</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.3x</color> AoE DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times. Gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=2015509>[Retaliation Enhancement]</buf> after combat for each target hit, stacking up to <color=#F74848>3</color> times per <color=#F74848>1</color> attack. Stacks up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times in total.

201504.name: Rapid Fire
201504.describe: Simultaneously uses two Machine Guns to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.7x</color> DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times. Gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=2015041>[Counter Burst]</buf>. Stacks up to <color=#F74848>3</color> times.

201505.name: Defense Line
201505.SpecificEffects: Allows allies within <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles to use Assault or Ranged Weapons to launch a <buf ID=900061>[Link Retaliation]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

201506.name: Tension Surge
201506.describe: Designates <color=#F74848>1</color> ally to receive <buf ID=2015061>[Sanctuary]</buf>, lasting until the target's next action begins. Can continue action with remaining Movement.

201507.name: United Effort
201507.SpecificEffects: When allies within <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles trigger <buf ID=900096>[Retaliation]</buf> and <buf ID=900061>[Link Retaliation]</buf>, DMG <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.

201508.name: Maelstrom
201508.describe:
Gains <buf ID=2015081>[Turning Point]</buf> and <buf ID=2015087>[Maelstrom]</buf>.
Does not consume <buf ID=2015509>[Retaliation Enhancement]</buf> when retaliating. Lasts until the next action begins.

201509.name: Armed and Ready
201509.describe: Uses a Machine Gun to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> DMG. After combat, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=2015509>[Retaliation Enhancement]</buf>. Stacks up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times.

200011.name: CEC 2
200011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

200021.name: CEC 3
200021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

200022.name: Power Innovation 2
200022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

200031.name: Perfect Position 1
200031.SpecificEffects: Unlock the Assault Weapon's <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf> ability. When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, final DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

200033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
200033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

200034.name: Perfect Position 2
200034.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+12%</color>.

200035.name: Perfect Position 3
200035.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+12%</color>.

200036.name: Perfect Position 4
200036.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, final DMG <color=#F74848>+30%</color>.

200043.name: Adaptive Warfare 2
200043.SpecificEffects:
Before actively attacking without having moved, can trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.
Effects similar to <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> cannot be re-triggered.

201541.name: Heavenly Fire 1
201541.SpecificEffects: At end of action, for each enemy within <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=2015509>[Retaliation Enhancement]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks.

201544.name: Heavenly Fire 2
201544.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900023>[Quick Draw]</buf> dispels <color=#F74848>1</color> buff from the attacker.

201545.name: Heavenly Fire 3
201545.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=2015509>[Retaliation Enhancement]</buf> is active, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.
